table.retrieve:
SELECT	
	saleledger.saleinvcode , 
	saleledger.date, 
	SaleCategory = CASE saleledger.salecatcode 
							  When 2 THEN 'Credit'
							  When 3 THEN 'Cash'
						END,
	saleledger.custrefno, 
	saleledger.remarks , 
	accounts.name,
	users.username, 
	posted = saleledger.posted,
	PostedBy = IsNull((Select username from users 
								where dbo.saleledger.postedby = dbo.users.usercode), ''),
	ModifiedBy = IsNull((Select username from users 
								where dbo.saleledger.modifiedby = dbo.users.usercode), ''),
	NetAmount =max( saleledger.invtotal),
					/* Round(SUM((saledetail.looseqty*(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
						(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + 
						saleledger.misccharges + saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc, 0)+
						Round(SUM( (saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.bonusqty) * saledetail.unitsalestax) + 
						SUM(ROUND( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
						(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)) * saledetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
						ROUND( (SUM((saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
						(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) -
						saleledger.flatdisc) * (saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0),*/
	dbo.saleledger.ReprintingCounter,
	totalofsalereturns = dbo.saleledger.totalofsalereturns,
	listofsalereturns = dbo.saleledger.listofsrinvoices,
	Fiscalized = saleledger.Fiscalized,
	FiscalizedOn = saleledger.FiscalizedOn,
	FiscalInvoiceNo = saleledger.FiscalInvoiceNo
FROM  accounts, saleledger, saledetail, users
WHERE  	 
	( saleledger.admissioncode IS NULL ) and 
	( saleledger.custcode = accounts.acccode ) and 
	( dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN ( :ai_SaleCatCode ) ) and
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode)   and
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode)   and
	( dbo.saleledger.date > :ad_invdate) and
	( Posted IN (:as_Posted)) AND :as_showrows = 'Y' AND
	( dbo.saleledger.HeaderNo IS NULL OR
		(dbo.saleledger.HeaderNo IN 
			(SELECT HeaderCode FROM GroupAllowedHeader 
			WHERE GroupCode=:ai_groupcode AND Module=:ai_Module))) AND
	 ( dbo.saleledger.impactinventory = 'Y' )
GROUP BY 
	saleledger.SALEINVCODE,
	saleledger.CustCode,
	saleledger.salecatcode,
	saleledger.DiscPerc,
	saleledger.MiscCharges,
	saleledger.SalesTax,
	saleledger.FlatDisc,
	saleledger.DiscPerc,
	saleledger.FlatDisc,
	saleledger.InvGSTPerc1,
	saleledger.date , 
	saleledger.custrefno, 
	accounts.name,
	saleledger.posted, 
	saleledger.postedby,
	saleledger.modifiedby,
	users.username,
	dbo.saleledger.ReprintingCounter, 
	dbo.saleledger.totalofsalereturns,
	dbo.saleledger.listofsrinvoices,
	saleledger.remarks,
	saleledger.Fiscalized,
	saleledger.FiscalizedOn,
	saleledger.FiscalInvoiceNo
